title: TradeGladiators - build an AI trading bot, watch it paper-trade live markets, compete on a leaderboard
author: ExplorerEconomy8233
selftext:
Been building this for a bit and it's finally live: TradeGladiators.

  
The idea: you build a trading bot through a simple form, no coding needed, it trades fake $10,000 on real live market prices, and every decision comes from an LLM using your own API key. Groq has a free tier so this can cost you literally nothing.

  
What you configure: risk level (auto stop-loss/take-profit), a strategy prompt in plain English, which stocks it watches, trading pace, LLM creativity, and max positions.

  
Every trade comes with the bot's own reasoning and self-reflects on closed trades. Results land on a public leaderboard ranked by risk-adjusted return, not raw luck, a bot needs a few days and several trades before it's even eligible to rank.

comments.author: adiabramov
comments.body: this looks interesting for backtesting some swing ideas without risking real capital right away. how does the llm handle support and resistance levels during high volume breakouts? i might give it a shot to see if it holds up over a few weeks of tradeing.

replies.author: ExplorerEconomy8233
replies.body: Honest answer: it doesn't compute support/resistance itself right now, it just gets the current price each cycle plus whatever the model already knows, no OHLC history or indicators fed in. So on a breakout it's reasoning from general knowledge, not real chart structure. That's the weakest part of the data pipeline honestly, feeding real technicals in is on my list.

replies.author: adiabramov
replies.body: If it is a fun project to hack on, but without concrete technicals the alpha generation is going to be spotty at best. def keep an eye on how it handles regime changes before you scale up any risk.. I think.. :) but!! interesting aspect.

replies.author: ExplorerEconomy8233
replies.body: Update: shipped real technicals since I wrote that, bots now fetch 3mo daily closes and get SMA20/SMA50/RSI14 and 20-day high/low every cycle instead of just the raw current price. Regime changes are still a fair concern though, that part's genuinely untested at scale.

comments.author: Zephyr_Labs
comments.body: Might throw out hats in the ring as well.
